COOKIES.TITLE: Cookie policy
COOKIES.S1B: Cookies are small files a site stores in your browser. Similar technologies exist, such as browser local storage and local databases (IndexedDB), which do similar jobs without being cookies.
COOKIES.S2B: Today Synapta uses NO first- or third-party cookies: no analytics, ads or trackers. We only use browser local storage, strictly necessary to work: session (to keep you logged in), language, visual theme and interface preferences (like Studio column widths). None of this is shared with third parties.
COOKIES.S3B: For strictly necessary storage, no: without it the app cannot work (e.g. remembering your session). If we ever add non-essential cookies (analytics or marketing), we will ask your prior authorization from the cookie banner and you will be able to accept or reject by category.
COOKIES.S4B: You may clear browser local storage from your browser settings anytime (note this logs you out and resets preferences). Once the cookie banner is active, you will also be able to change your choice from the “Cookies” footer link.
COOKIES.S5B: We process this technical data under Colombia's Law 1581 of 2012 and its regulations. Authentication data is processed under the authorization you grant when creating your account; functional data, as necessary to provide the service you requested.
COOKIES.S6B: We will update this policy if we add new storage technologies or third parties. The current version will always be on this page and, if a change needs your authorization, we will ask before applying it.
